per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow users to book a room in 5 minutes or less on their first attempt.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should require minimal training for basic tasks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support screen readers, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast modes to comply with ADA standards.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle 1,000 concurrent requests initially, scaling to 2,000 by the next release.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should complete 90% of tasks in 5 seconds or less and 98% of tasks in 8 seconds or less.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should achieve 99.99% uptime, excluding total server loss events.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should automatically capture and transmit exception logs to the support team.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support English, Spanish, French, and German at launch.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow customer branding (logo, colors, fonts) while enforcing accessibility guardrails (e.g., contrast ratios).
